citations.assessment: The midrash names Dostai son of Yannai and Rabbi Sava as instructors. The underlying Kings story has an unnamed priest, while the biblical Shalmaneser notice is further up the chapter.
The Tanchuma parallel gives Dostai bar Yannai and Rabbi Saviyya. This corroborates the named pair in the parallel tradition; the exact Yelammedenu witness remains uncollated.
The retrieved text names Rabbi Dostai and Rabbi Yannai as separate figures. Radal’s lemma gives Rabbi Dostai and Rabbi Zekharyah and explicitly sets the Tanchuma and Yalkut form beside it.
